title: MySwimPro Session Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Swim.com workouts (`swimcom:workout`), MySwimPro sessions (`myswimpro:session`), pool lap logs (`pool:lap`), and swim meet results (`swim:meet`).
app: Swim.com workout exports, MySwimPro session logs, pool lap counters, swim meet results, and interval pace trackers forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=myswimpro:session
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(drill_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many MySwimPro session events land each day and how many distinct drill values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest MySwimPro session records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct drill values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how much MySwimPro session activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
